# Where We Eatin' — Live Food Truck Directory & Event Booking (Pueblo, CO & 120-Mile Radius)
> Live food truck discovery directory and mobile vendor radar homed in Pueblo, Colorado and serving food trucks, diners, and event organizers across a 120-mile radius (Pueblo, Pueblo West, Colorado Springs, Fountain, Cañon City, Monument, Castle Rock, Salida, Walsenburg, Trinidad, and La Junta).

## Platform Overview
- **Platform Name:** Where We Eatin'
- **Home Base:** Pueblo, Colorado (120-mile radius coverage across Southern CO & Front Range)
- **Official Website:** https://whereeatin.com/

## Verified Vendor Tiers & Event Deposits (USD)
- **Free Tier:** $0 / month (basic vendor directory listing)
- **Professional Vendor Tier:** $15 / month
- **Premier Vendor Tier:** $35 / month
- **Private Event / Festival Booking Deposit:** $250
